title: Defect Conformal Manifolds along RG Domain Walls between Z_N-Parafermions and Minimal Models
abstract: Studies defect conformal manifolds along RG domain walls between Z_N parafermion CFTs (c=2(N-1)/(N+2)) and minimal models M_{N+1}, including a spin-2 W^(3)-descendant operator on the wall, exactly computed parameter-dependent transmission coefficients, and non-invertible so(3)_N symmetry tracking.
key_claims: RG domain walls connect Z_N parafermion CFTs to minimal models M_{N+1}: N=2 is Ising c=1/2 and N=3 is 3-state Potts c=4/5 -- i.e. the walls link the exact CFT classes on the project's universality ladder (Ising, TCI, Potts).

A spin-2 W^(3)-descendant operator on the wall constrains stress-tensor mixing across the defect -- the spin-2/stress sector is the rigid, protected structure across these theories, conceptually adjacent to the stress-tensor-exchange mechanism behind alpha=4=2*Delta_T.

Exactly computed, parameter-dependent transmission coefficients on the defect conformal manifold -- natural benchmarks if the project ever probes interfaces between its three CFT classes in MERA (e.g. a TCI-Potts wall).
Non-invertible so(3)_N symmetry tracking is the modern categorical-symmetry framing of the Kramers-Wannier-type structures exploited in the Z2 C_sss selection-rule probe.
relevance_note: WATCH (deferred from scan #13, catalogued scan #14). Formal context for the HYP-025 Potts lineage rather than a simulation target. The wall physics reaffirms that the spin-2/stress sector is protected across the Ising/TCI/Potts ladder (consistent with alpha=4 universality, HYP-027/025), and the exact transmission coefficients become benchmarks only if a cross-class MERA interface experiment is ever attempted. No routing required.
anchor_contradiction: None. No direct contradiction or sharpening of any anchor; conceptually consistent with the protected spin-2/stress-tensor sector behind alpha=4=2*Delta_T.
